what: First loader veil — for first-time visitors, an accent-color veil covers the screen and a logo mark (Lottie) is drawn at its center (100px), rests 1 more second after 1.5s, then the mark shrinks to .8x and fades over 1s power2.out while the veil disappears over 1.5s power1.out (4 seconds total). For visitors arriving from within the site (same-origin referrer), no mark — just a background-color veil that waits .5s and clears over 1.5s power1.out. At the end it removes the veil and fires fx:done

options.hold: Seconds to wait while the mark animates, default 1.5
options.delay: Delay in seconds after waiting before it disappears, default 1
options.mark-dur: Duration for the mark to shrink and fade (s), default 1
options.scale: Scale at which the mark shrinks, default .8
options.mode: Locks in the first-or-again distinction with first·again (demo, app). Default is decided by referrer
options.src: (If present) Lottie JSON URL to play once in the mark spot — load lottie-web first
options.ease: GSAP curve for the curtain disappearing, default power1.out

note: Since this part makes people wait, screens that get flipped often like in an app use hold: 0; delay: 0; Written in short form like dur: .3. The original code puts ease: on the curtain: "Linear" was specified, but TweenMax 1.19 does not know that name and runs the default curve Power1.easeOut — the measured screen is also power1.out, so that value is the default
